questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to deliberate?
questions.explanation: Deliberate can mean carefully considered or intentional, so careful is the closest choice here.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to obscure?
questions.explanation: To obscure something is to make it difficult to see or understand, so hide is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to novice?
questions.explanation: A novice is someone new to an activity, so beginner is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to fragile?
questions.explanation: Fragile means easily damaged, while sturdy means strong and resistant to damage.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to frequent?
questions.explanation: Frequent means happening often, while rare means happening infrequently.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to generous?
questions.explanation: Generous describes willingness to give; selfish describes concern mainly for oneself.

questions.prompt: Rudder is to ship as steering wheel is to ____.
questions.explanation: A rudder controls the direction of a ship, while a steering wheel controls the direction of an automobile.

questions.prompt: Scales are to weight as ruler is to ____.
questions.explanation: Scales measure weight, while a ruler measures length or distance.

questions.prompt: Author is to novel as sculptor is to ____.
questions.explanation: An author creates a novel, just as a sculptor creates a statue.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Orbit, rotate, and revolve describe types of motion; evaporate describes a change of state.

questions.prompt: Maple, birch, and oak belong to the same group. Which word belongs with them?
questions.explanation: Maple, birch, oak, and pine are all trees.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Fraction, decimal, and percent are forms of numerical representation; paragraph is a unit of writing.

questions.prompt: A workshop has three sessions: morning, midday, and afternoon. Art must occur before music. Science must occur after music. Which subject must be in the afternoon?
questions.explanation: Art must come first, music second, and science after music, so science must be in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Every bronze token is round. No round token is stored in Box C. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.A: Every token outside Box C is bronze.
choices.B: No bronze token is stored in Box C.

questions.correctAnswer: No bronze token is stored in Box C.
questions.explanation: All bronze tokens are round, and no round token is in Box C, so no bronze token can be there.

questions.prompt: Four books—J, K, L, and M—are arranged in a row. K is immediately after J. M is before J. L is after K. Which book must be first?
questions.explanation: The constraints force the order M, J, K, L, so M must be first.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to frugal?
questions.explanation: Frugal means careful about spending or using resources, so economical is closest.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to diminish?
questions.explanation: To diminish means to make or become smaller or less.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to vigilant?
questions.explanation: Vigilant means alert and watchful for possible problems.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to rigid?
questions.explanation: Rigid means stiff or inflexible, so flexible is its clearest opposite.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to compulsory?
questions.explanation: Compulsory means required, whereas optional means not required.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to temporary?
questions.explanation: Temporary means lasting for a limited time; permanent means lasting indefinitely.

questions.prompt: Larva is to butterfly as tadpole is to ____.
questions.explanation: A larva develops into a butterfly, just as a tadpole develops into a frog.

questions.prompt: Bark is to tree as shell is to ____.
questions.explanation: Bark is an outer covering of a tree, and a shell is an outer covering of a turtle.

questions.prompt: Apprentice is to master as student is to ____.
questions.explanation: An apprentice learns from a master, just as a student learns from a teacher.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Violin, cello, and viola are bowed string instruments; trumpet is a brass instrument.

questions.prompt: Copper, iron, and aluminum belong to the same group. Which word belongs with them?
questions.explanation: Copper, iron, aluminum, and silver are metals.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Tiny, minute, and miniature describe something very small, while enormous describes something very large.

questions.prompt: A museum tour visits exactly four rooms: P, Q, R, and S. Q is visited before R. S is visited immediately before P. R is not last. Which room must be last?
questions.explanation: Since S must be immediately before P and R cannot be last, the only valid ordering places P last.

questions.prompt: If the library is open, then the study room is available. The study room is not available. What must be true?

choices.B: The library may or may not be open.

questions.explanation: By contraposition, if availability is required whenever the library is open, unavailable means the library cannot be open.

questions.prompt: All cedar boxes are wooden. Some wooden boxes have brass hinges. Which statement is guaranteed?

choices.B: Some cedar boxes have brass hinges.
choices.C: No cedar boxes have brass hinges.

questions.explanation: The first statement directly guarantees that every cedar box belongs to the wooden-box category.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to meticulous?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means extremely careful and precise about details.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to feasible?
questions.explanation: Feasible means possible or practical to accomplish.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to candid?
questions.explanation: Candid means open and honest in expression.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to obscure?
questions.explanation: Obscure can mean little known; famous is its clearest opposite in this context.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to expand?
questions.explanation: To expand is to become larger; to contract is to become smaller.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to reckless?
questions.explanation: Reckless means acting without enough care, while cautious means careful about risk.

questions.prompt: Page is to book as brick is to ____.
questions.explanation: A page is a component of a book, while a brick is a component of a wall.

questions.prompt: Scales are to fish as feathers are to ____.
questions.explanation: Scales cover a fish, while feathers cover a bird.

questions.prompt: Sextant is to navigator as gavel is to ____.
questions.explanation: A navigator characteristically uses a sextant, while a judge characteristically uses a gavel.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Orchid, tulip, and daffodil are flowering plants; a fern reproduces without flowers.

questions.prompt: Mercury, Venus, and Mars belong to the same group. Which word belongs with them?
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, Mars, and Saturn are planets.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Triangle, pentagon, and hexagon are two-dimensional polygons; a sphere is a three-dimensional solid.

questions.prompt: Four folders W, X, Y, and Z are stacked from top to bottom. W is above X. X is above Z. Y is below Z. Which folder must be on top?
questions.explanation: The constraints force W above X above Z above Y, so W must be on top.

questions.prompt: Every member of the robotics team attends the safety briefing. Priya is a member of the robotics team. What must be true?

choices.B: Everyone at the briefing is on the robotics team.

questions.explanation: The rule applies to every robotics-team member, and Priya is explicitly identified as one.

questions.prompt: A workshop offers pottery only on Tuesday or Thursday. Elena attends pottery, but she cannot attend on Thursday. When does Elena attend?
questions.explanation: Pottery is offered only Tuesday or Thursday, and Thursday is excluded, so Elena must attend Tuesday.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to resilient?
questions.explanation: Resilient describes something able to recover or remain strong, making durable the closest choice.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to concise?
questions.explanation: Concise means expressed in few words without unnecessary detail.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to verify?
questions.explanation: To verify something is to confirm that it is accurate or true.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to abundant?
questions.explanation: Abundant means plentiful, while scarce means present in limited supply.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to tranquil?
questions.explanation: Tranquil means calm or peaceful; restless is the clearest opposite.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to permit?
questions.explanation: To permit is to allow something; to refuse it is to deny permission.

questions.prompt: Hive is to bee as den is to ____.
questions.explanation: A hive is a dwelling associated with a bee, and a den is a dwelling associated with a fox.

questions.prompt: Wool is to sweater as clay is to ____.
questions.explanation: Wool is material used to make a sweater; clay is material used to make pottery.

questions.prompt: Hunger is to eat as fatigue is to ____.
questions.explanation: Eating responds to hunger, just as resting responds to fatigue.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Quartz is a mineral, while granite, marble, and limestone are rocks.

questions.prompt: Copper, silver, and gold share which objective category?
questions.explanation: Copper, silver, and gold are all metals.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with canyon, valley, and gorge?
questions.explanation: A ravine, like a canyon, valley, and gorge, is a low landform between higher sides.

questions.prompt: Five runners finish a race. N finishes before P but after R. T finishes after P. S finishes before R. Who must finish first?
questions.explanation: The order constraints force S before R before N before P before T, so S must finish first.

questions.prompt: If a package is marked EXPRESS, it is placed on Cart 2. This package is not on Cart 2. What must be true?
questions.explanation: By the contrapositive of the stated rule, a package not on Cart 2 cannot be marked EXPRESS.

questions.prompt: Exactly one of Room A and Room B is open. Room A is open. Which statement must be true?

choices.D: A third room must be open.

questions.explanation: If exactly one of the two rooms is open and Room A is open, Room B must be closed.
